chunks: Other than him who turns his back and denies,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'turn back and deny' in the context of Surah Al-Ghashiyah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this segment from Surah Al-Ghashiyah underscores the ultimate fate of those who reject the Imamate and divine authority, linking 'turning away' (tawalla) to spiritual alienation. It serves as a critical eschatological warning, contrasting the believers' salvation with the disbelievers' eternal ruin, a theme central to Shia theological discussions on obedience to the Ahl al-Bayt.
